csv_project_name: OR Services for Affordable Employee Housing Development
csv_scope_of_work: The Steamboat Springs School District RE-2 (District) is soliciting Statements of Interest, Qualifications and Proposals from qualified firms to provide Owner s Representative Services to assist the District in the pre-development work and pre-construction work for new affordable employee housing. The purpose of this RFQ&P is to seek a qualified Owner s Representative to complete important pre-development work, and assist in reviewing proposals from qualified developers to provide a financially feasible plan to develop the site, inclusive of utilities, and design and construct approximately 20 employee residences on an existing 2.23 acres owned by the Steamboat Springs School District near the Sleeping Giant School.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Site Evaluation/Selection, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Redevelopment Planning, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Structural Engineering, Urban Studies/Planning/Design

relevance_explanation:
- The tender is primarily for owner's representative and advisory services, not direct structural or bridge design.

- No indication of complex, long-span, lightweight, or architecturally demanding structures.
- Structural engineering is only one of several listed disciplines and appears secondary.
- The brief includes planning and developer proposal review rather than concrete engineering design scope.
